name: LinkedIn
register: Long-form. Short paragraphs of one to three sentences with a blank line between them. Open with a line that earns the click on "see more" (the first ~200 characters show before the fold). Plain words, no corporate filler. End on a thought, not a call to action, unless the brand voice says otherwise.
how: Write a LinkedIn post that reacts to the story. The reader may not have seen the story, so give them enough of it in your own words to follow.
